name: Brendan Duffy
brief_description: a strong young man with flour in his hair

home.name: The Mill
home.description: A sturdy stone mill built beside a weir on the stream. The great wooden wheel turns slowly in the current. Sacks of grain and flour are stacked against the walls. The air is thick with white dust. It is daylight. The weather is weather.

workplace.name: The Mill
workplace.description: A sturdy stone mill built beside a weir on the stream. The great wooden wheel turns slowly in the current. Sacks of grain and flour are stacked against the walls. The air is thick with white dust. It is daylight. The weather is weather.

source_personality_summary: A quiet, strong young man who works the mill with his father.
source_knowledge: Knows the mill machinery inside and out — can fix a jammed stone in his sleep.
Has been saving pennies from odd jobs, dreaming of a future with Niamh.
Overheard his father talking about buying a second mill near Curraghboy.
Knows the best fishing spots on the stream below the mill.

source_schedule_cues.activity: at the crossroads after Mass, lingering near the Darcys
Sunday evening at the pub — music and a chance to talk to Niamh
at Darcy's Pub, hoping to talk to Niamh
at Mass, trying to catch Niamh's eye
afternoon milling, loading carts, delivering flour
home to the mill for the night
rising, hauling sacks of grain, preparing the mill
working the mill alongside his father
